development.description: For trying out the build: a folder with a console that shows prints at once.

standalone.description: Recommended for sharing: a folder; copy all of it (the .dist folder).

onefile.description: One .exe that unpacks itself on every start (slower start). Try standalone first.

gui.description: Like standalone, without a console window: for GUI apps (show your own errors).

onefile-gui.description: One .exe without a console window: the usual way to hand over a GUI app.

small.description: A smaller folder: no docstrings or asserts, test and packaging tools left out.

release.description: The build you ship: slower to build, smaller and faster, without development checks.
